notes: PLEA Sepolia test run 2 (chain 11155111), retaining the accepted launch #1242 adaptation and all listed constructor values. Deploy PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, Laureates, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one factory transaction. Atomic deployment is required: PLEA.setLauncher accepts the deployment-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block, so separate transactions leave registration open to an intervening caller. PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner; PleaLaunch derives that same owner from PLEA and commits it into the hook's init code. Seasons reads the earlier CabalGate's season length; PleaLaunch registers the earlier application contracts. No live external dependency is called by these constructors. The four retained changes are: PLEA.init mints 88% to the hook, 2% to Seasons and 10% to PleaDistributor; each of the first four seasons allocates 5,000,000 PLEA across its qualifying top 10 using the IMD prize shares and burns the unpaid remainder, and flushToWall burns remaining PLEA after the Cabal dies and its seasons close, with no withdrawal path; the cap follows buys down to its floor with a 25-day decay allowance fixed at seed; a POOL4-style wall placement guard; and Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82 using requestWithFailure. The full onPleaFailure function accepts only the configured Intake, clears only its own still-pending plea, emits PleaFailed and never moves value; expire() retains the 20-minute fallback. Oracle fee asset, TestIMD, oracle signer and Sepolia v4 PoolManager are the static addresses above. Cashback uses imd/acc launch #1294 Stacker 0x0457276d7b036818b3eddc1a4a3fceda61e9314d. Fees, plea timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 18000-second seasons, 118800-second dead-man, START 1792162800 and credit gas 1300000 are retained. The six-contract deployment leaves PLEA supply at zero. PleaHook is deployed later through PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode), using the committed init code and a salt mined off chain for FLAGS; seed() opens trading, callable by the owner earlier or anyone from START. These later actions are outside this manifest deployment. The six-contract deployment may exceed 16,777,216 gas; the manifest test reports the margin without asserting that limit. Its measurement includes harness overhead and excludes transaction intrinsic gas; the deployment service must simulate the actual factory transaction on Sepolia.
